about: Errors that end a console's setup or the console, as the core words them (without the stage in front), with the class it sends as their code (names.json, codes; "" for none). internal/protocol/errcode_test.go makes the connection errors for real and checks their codes; UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 writes their rows anew, with PORT and NOW for what changes from run to run. Each driver's tests check the rows of its own errors word for word (testkit.ErrorRow). desktop/families_test.cpp checks that each message gets the hint of its code.
